name: Zero-Trust Cybersecurity Overhaul
description: A comprehensive enterprise-wide programme to migrate the organisation's security posture from a traditional perimeter-based model to a Zero-Trust Architecture (ZTA). The programme encompasses identity and access management (IAM) modernisation, network micro-segmentation, implementation of a Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) platform, endpoint detection and response (EDR) tooling, and a mandatory third-party penetration test by SecureCheck Ltd. to validate controls prior to go-live. Compliance certification under GDPR Article 32 (technical and organisational security measures) is the formal programme exit gate, with a regulatory submission deadline of 18 September 2026. The programme is currently on hold pending resolution of a critical procurement blocker: the engagement contract with SecureCheck Ltd. has not been signed, preventing the penetration test workstream from commencing. Without a completed pen test report, GDPR certification cannot be applied for. Failure to certify before the deadline carries a regulatory fine exposure of up to £2.3 million under UK GDPR enforcement guidelines.
